$comment: Every place the console bundle can create a <style> element (card S02).
scripts/seal-web-config.mjs counts createElement("style") and a JSX <style> with
dangerouslySetInnerHTML across dist/assets/*.js and refuses the build when the
total differs from `count`. A new site means a new inline style: allow it by
hash (pnpm csp:collect) or make it an adopted stylesheet, then list it here.

sites.source: input-otp: empty #input-otp-style, rules via insertRule (empty text hashed)
react-dom: hoisted <style precedence> resources (no such element in this code)
style-mod (patched): fallback when the document cannot adopt a sheet
react-style-singleton (patched): fallback when the document cannot adopt a sheet
packages/ui use-adopted-style-sheet: the two fallbacks (adoptStyleSheet, setDocumentStyleSheet)
